changelog:
- Version bump: 1.6.0.
- Added support for the new video model `video-seedance-2` (up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos, 3 audio, 4–15 sec, 480p/720p/1080p, whitelist required).
- Updated documentation: Video model endpoints are now specific per model (`/video-v1-fast` and `/video-seedance-2`); old `/video-generation` endpoint is removed.
- Removed the file `skill-card.md`.
